experiment: M6-I: a new intel-host experiment targeting the baseline image warm.completion loss (1.21 [1.14,1.30] against Dawn). It reuses the mechanism hunk of the amd-host M6 patch (not promoted there; no completion effect in the amd-host copy size sweep). It is not a rerun of anything and does not count for RADV.
candidate: 703ba96bf + candidates/m6-barriers.patch (the runtime/c/backends/vulkan/src/commands.c hunk of amd-vulkan/20261029-dropin-phase/m6/candidate.patch; its Makefile hunk is already on main)
mechanism: Barriers between commands of one recording use device-only scopes (ALL_COMMANDS -> ALL_COMMANDS, MEMORY_WRITE -> MEMORY_READ|MEMORY_WRITE); only the final barrier of each recording adds the HOST stage and HOST_READ. Host writes before vkQueueSubmit are covered by the submission's implicit host-write ordering, and host access to a recorded buffer is refused while it has recorded uses.
intelHypothesis: On ANV a barrier whose destination includes HOST_READ/HOST stage may force data-cache flushes on every command; main records 4 such barriers per dispatch submit. Inference from driver behavior, not verified.
sharedCode: The mechanism is device-agnostic and changes the shared Vulkan recording path used on RADV. Any adoption needs a separate RADV rerun under its own contract; this result cannot authorize it.

sampling.inputs: frozen inputs (manifest afe4e1d3) and independent oracles
sampling.powerBasis: No intel-host prior exists, so the pair count is not power-derived; 192 equals the largest amd-host round-4 count and costs a few minutes per window here.

metric: complete = compileNs + pipelineNs + resourcesNs + sum of every iteration's operation interval + teardownNs (CPU oracle excluded). Ratios are candidate/main per balanced pair; bootstrap 95% CI, 10000 resamples, seed 20261029.

acceptance.target: image_rgba_invert_1024: complete CI95 upper < 1.0 AND warm.completion CI95 upper < 1.0
acceptance.otherBound: vector_scale_add_262k and buffer_upload_readback_exact_1mb: complete CI95 upper <= 1.02
acceptance.phaseGuard: no warm phase on any workload with ratio CI95 lower > 1.05
acceptance.verdict: pass only if every workload window is valid and target, otherBound and phaseGuard hold (tools/gate_m6.py)

validity: Each workload runs in its own window under tools/gated-window.sh. A window is INVALID if the intel window gate fails (foreign GPU > 2% of wall time from i915 fdinfo of non-harness clients, foreign CPU > 5% of capacity, or a `make -C runtime/c` process seen), any process fails or misses an oracle, or the A/A check fails (dawn-aa/dawn warm.operation median within [0.95,1.05] with CI95 containing 1). Gate-invalid windows rerun automatically (max 4); an A/A-invalid window reruns fresh once. Invalid data are retained and never used for the verdict.
